candidates.failure_scenario: `func F(_ realm, cur int) int { p := &cur; *p = 5; return cur }` in a realm package compiles and prints 5 at the merge base. At 6d88deba7 preprocess aborts the whole package with `cannot take the address of a realm-typed `cur`: the binding is fixed for the life of the frame ...` on an int.
